title: Genetic Animals Touch-Ups
description: Retextures several Genetic Animals items to align closer to the modern art style and renames the different saddles and collars to be distinguishable from each other.
body:
Retextures several of [Genetic Animals](https://modrinth.com/mod/genetic-animals)' items to look more modern as well as gives the mod's identically named saddles, bridles, collars, and meat items individually distinct names for more distinguishability and searchability. Renames are only in US English.

Should probably work on older versions?
